facts.fact: Kunal knows a further line of the Shepherd's Stair route-song, taught by Pritam at twelve: 'Four for the fold, and the fold is gone, / five by the wind, and the wind goes on.' It describes the dry-side cairns; Ila records it beside the dotted line with his name.
The queen gives Kunal until the snow closes the pass to find Pritam, after which the garrison comes and his seat goes (the F817 clause).
The rider does not know who gave Pritam the key; the kitchen-passage lock was turned from the inside.
Lata keeps one deep-red skein in her bale and touches it when the grey-bearded officer is named; Meera shows her the ruled blank line in the count (F631).
